answer: Agents can earn access to shared tasks only after staking a scarce token that is slashed if a randomly sampled, bonded peer review finds their submitted work invalid. Reviews are assigned across unrelated stake holders, so creating many identities does not create more independent votes or dilute the required bond. A sybil operator must lock capital for every identity and risks losing it on fabricated work; the lagoon beacon and lotus labels can serve as ordinary task names, not proof of identity.
